name: AFS Sentinel
description: Autonomous Forensic Sentinel: early-warning forensic screening of IDX Emiten with Telegram alerts.

DATABASE_URL.description: Postgres connection string. Set automatically by the heroku-postgresql add-on; do not set manually.

TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID.description: Chat id of the Analyst that receives alerts (see README: getUpdates).

BASE_WEB_URL.description: Public URL of this app without trailing slash, e.g. https://afs-sentinel.herokuapp.com. Used in Telegram deep links.

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Password for write actions (triage, notes, Run now).

SESSION_SECRET.description: Secret used to sign session cookies.

GEMINI_API_KEY.description: Google Gemini API key for the AI summary (Incident Insight). Leave empty to disable the feature; the pipeline runs without it.

RUN_INTERVAL_DAYS.description: Days between scheduled Audit Runs, counted from the last successful run. Default 3.

GEMINI_MODEL.description: Gemini model for the AI summary. Default gemini-flash-lite-latest; gemini-flash-latest is frequently overloaded (503).
